name: roommix
description: Real-time audio mixing service for face-to-face translation: core library, WebSocket server, browser simulator.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:server: gcloud run deploy f2f-audio-mixer --source . --project f2f-audio-mixer --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 8080 --memory 512Mi --max-instances 1 --session-affinity --timeout 3600 --quiet
scripts.release:web: VITE_WS_URL="wss://$(gcloud run services describe f2f-audio-mixer --project f2f-audio-mixer --region europe-west1 --format 'value(status.url)' | sed 's#^https://##')/ws" pnpm --filter @roommix/simulator build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project f2f-audio-mixer
